episodes.name: Generation Why
episodes.overviewEn: Kamala Khan attends Avengercon only to discover that she herself might have superpowers.

episodes.name: Crushed
episodes.overviewEn: Kamala and Bruno explore the source of her newfound powers just in time for a perilous adventure.

episodes.name: Destined
episodes.overviewEn: Ahead of Aamir’s wedding, Kamala may face grave consequences due to a crucial decision she makes.

episodes.name: Seeing Red
episodes.overviewEn: Kamala travels around the world to solve the mystery of the bangle and her family’s history.

episodes.name: Time and Again
episodes.overviewEn: The bangle reveals to Kamala secrets about her family lineage, as well as the truth behind the Veil.

episodes.name: No Normal
episodes.overviewEn: Back in Jersey, Kamala finds Kamran and protects him from Damage Control who will stop at nothing to take him in.
